headline: IMPERIAL TROOPS CRUSH SATSUMA REBELS AT SHIROYAMA
dispatch: KAGOSHIMA, Sept. 25. Imperial troops have carried the rebel position on Shiroyama after a final assault on the Satsuma stronghold. Saigo Takamori, leader of the rebellion against the new government, is reported dead, and organized resistance in the field has ended.
answer: Imperial troops defeat Satsuma rebels at Shiroyama, 1877
